note.ja: 風上角度FV／M1のRusanovとSSPRK2。吸収は保存ledger付き指数分割。6軸重み1/6、単位beamのnodal強度6、Pzzと全3Dtraceを保持。floor/projectionはしません。 旧c1 Rusanovの横拡散による3不合格を保持し、一般状態の方向別Jacobian固有値・LF円錐分割・法線flux比の最大を一面係数に採用。全ghost面と台帳へ同じfluxを使い、真空と既存許容丸め域の速度だけ1へ拡張して回数・最大超過を記録します。U/Pの投影や純beam特例branchはありません。
note.en: Conservative upwind angular finite volumes or M1 Rusanov fluxes with SSPRK2; exponential absorption with a separate deposited-energy ledger. Six axis directions have weight1/6; a unit beam has nodal intensity6. Retain Pzz and the full3D trace. No positive floor or cone projection. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure.

name.ja: 静止媒質の灰色放射輸送・散乱・線形交換
name.en: Static grey radiative transfer,scattering and linear exchange

note.ja: 正規化した角度平均を使います。物質交換は1997輸送例と周期Fourier比較で進めます。1997の光学座標では係数1、物理座標の比較ではκを放射・物質の両交換項に掛けます。 2D空間と3D角度測度、c1、静止吸収体。実S_Nと非線形M1を24/48/96格子で進め、同一solverの変動方向MMS・x/y交差packet controlを保持。
note.en: Use a normalized angular mean. Material exchange is evolved in the1997 transport example and periodic Fourier controls. The1997 optical coordinates give a unit exchange coefficient; physical-coordinate controls multiply both exchange terms by kappa. Two spatial dimensions, a three-dimensional angular measure, c=1 and static absorption. Evolve the actual signed-angle and nonlinear M1 equations on24/48/96grids. Same-solver controls retain a varying-direction manufactured solution and crossed x/y packets.

name.ja: 静止媒質・平坦時空の灰色M1モーメント
name.en: Static grey M1 moments in flat spacetime

note.ja: c=1、2D空間で3D圧力のPzzを保持。等方・真空分岐、閉じたPDEの製造解、角度法とのビーム差を区別し、相対論的放射流体とは扱いません。 2D空間と3D角度測度、c1、静止吸収体。実S_Nと非線形M1を24/48/96格子で進め、同一solverの変動方向MMS・x/y交差packet controlを保持。
note.en: c=1,2D space with full3D pressure including Pzz. Separate isotropic/vacuum branches,closed-PDE MMS and beam defects against angular transport; no relativistic-fluid claim. Two spatial dimensions, a three-dimensional angular measure, c=1 and static absorption. Evolve the actual signed-angle and nonlinear M1 equations on24/48/96grids. Same-solver controls retain a varying-direction manufactured solution and crossed x/y packets.

name.ja: 反向伝播packetの特性線参照

note.ja: 解析解 2D空間に3D角度測度を用い、c=1の軸に整列した光線を扱います。実際の符号付き角度輸送と非線形の閉じたM1方程式をともに進めます。解析特性線の参照はRTE/S_Nに適用し、M1解全体の厳密参照とはしません。 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference 2Dspace with3Dangular measure,c1. Pure aligned rays; actual signed-angle transport and nonlinear closed M1 both evolved. The analytic characteristic reference applies to RTE/S_N,not to the entire M1 solution. Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented.
